checks.command: pytest -q tests/test_local_threat_model_coverage.py tests/test_owasp_llm_risk_crosswalk.py tests/test_prompt_injection.py tests/test_untrusted_input.py tests/test_clinical_model_authority.py tests/test_clinical_model_failure_mapping.py tests/test_artifact_scope.py

supported_claims: The local threat model covers browser capture/storage, upload/API, worker, model prompt, note/approval, export, audit/log and backup/deletion boundaries.
Transcript content, spoken quotes and filenames are treated as untrusted data; deterministic checks and proposals do not establish safety.
A crosswalk maps all ten OWASP GenAI LLM Top 10 2026 risks to local evidence, partial/not-applicable status and an explicit gap.
The current project scope restricts benchmark and clinical evaluation content to synthetic/public mock data pending institutional permission and independent review.
limitations: Crosswalk status is developer-maintained control mapping, not OWASP certification or external security audit.
Prompt-injection tests are static synthetic cases and do not establish adaptive, hidden Unicode or multimodal robustness.
No real-patient data, qualified external security reviewer or institutional release approval is claimed.
